messages:
Sarah Kim (Finance): Heads up — invoice LL-2026-03 looks wrong. We were on the 100k commit pilot but there's an `overage` charge of 12,400 units. Our dashboard shows ~78k units used. @Anil Shah can you pull the raw usage that fed this invoice?
Jordan Patel (Billing Ops): Invoice ID and PDF? I can start a preliminary reconcile but need the per-sku line items.
Sarah Kim (Finance): Invoice PDF attached in thread (LL-2026-03.pdf). invoice number LL-2026-03. Pasting the summary we see:
```
SKU,Committed,Used,Billed
embed-units,100000,78012,78012
gen-units,0,3200,3200
overage,0,12400,12400
Total,100000,81512,12400
```
Jordan Patel (Billing Ops): Looks like overage = 12,400 units at vendor rate. Need timestamped usage export to match to our logs. @Mike Ortega any jobs that might have spiked usage?
Mike Ortega (Eng): Not that I know of. We did run a one-off full-corpus embedding on Mar 2 in sandbox (~15k embeddings) but that was under project `sandbox-lumen` and should be excluded from pilot billing. I'll check job ids.
ProcureBot: Reminder: Contract LUM-RED-2025 auto-renew window opens in 27 days. Flagged for review if credit requested.
Anil Shah (LumenLedger): Sorry for the trouble — I will pull raw usage export for LL-2026-03 and map by project tag + API key. Quick Q: confirm account id and in-scope projects for pilot?
Sarah Kim (Finance): Account: redwood-prod (acct id rwd_4321). Pilot project: `redwood-ll-pilot` only. Sandbox projects tagged `sandbox-*` must be excluded.
Anil Shah (LumenLedger): Got it. I'll scope by project tag and API key, and include API key hashes/timestamps. Rate card excerpt: embeddings $0.0005/unit, generation $0.0012/unit, overage billed at embedded rate after commit exhausted. I'll have CSV + mapping by EOD PST and propose corrections if mis-attributed.
Jordan Patel (Billing Ops): Please include API key hashes for suspicious calls. We'll reconcile against our internal logs and open a credit request if LumenLedger confirms mis-bill.
Mike Ortega (Eng): Found job id job_20260302_fullcorpus (Mar 2 03:12 UTC). It used API key `sk-rl-********` (sandbox key). I can paste the manifest if needed.
Anil Shah (LumenLedger): Thanks — paste the first 10 lines or DM the manifest and I'll cross-check. If we find mis-attribution we'll escalate and issue post-audit credit.
Sarah Kim (Finance): If vendor-side tagging caused this, can we get a provisional credit before renewal discussions? ProcureBot flagged the renewal window and we want financials cleared first.
Anil Shah (LumenLedger): Understood. Standard practice is post-audit credit for confirmed mis-bills. I'll escalate and aim to have a proposed credit note for March by EOD.
Jordan Patel (Billing Ops): Once we have CSV + key mapping we'll reconcile and confirm next steps.
Sarah Kim (Finance): Action items: 1) @Anil share usage CSV + API key mapping by EOD. 2) @Mike share job manifest and confirm sandbox key (done). 3) @Jordan open internal billing ticket and ping procurement if credit requested.
Anil Shah (LumenLedger): On it — will post the export here shortly. Apologies again for the noise. :bow:
